newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKIING-DOWNHILL SPECIALISTS' EQUIPMENT GOES ASTRAY.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-DOWNHILL SPECIALISTS' EQUIPMENT GOES ASTRAY.

text.p: A men's downhill, scheduled for Val d'Isere on Saturday, may be held outside the World Cup after the skiers' equipment was lost in a plane transfer, the race jury said on Wednesday.
The equipment went missing between Vancouver airport and France, forcing race organisers to cancel the first official training.

It had not arrived on Wednesday evening and the race jury said they were considering staging the race outside the World Cup if there was any risk that a team would be handicapped because of the delay.
Race organisers hoped the equipment would reach the French resort on Thursday.
